title: RSS & Atom Feed Reader: News, Blogs, Podcasts to JSON
description: Turn any RSS, Atom or JSON feed into clean JSON: title, link, date, author, categories, summary, full content, images, and podcast audio links with durations. Give it feed URLs or just website addresses (the feed is found automatically). Filter by date, many feeds per run.

feeds.title: Feeds or websites
feeds.description: RSS/Atom/JSON feed URLs, or website pages that link to a feed. Up to 2,000 per run.

maxItemsPerFeed.title: Maximum items per feed
maxItemsPerFeed.description: Newest items as ordered by the feed.

publishedWithinDays.title: Published within (days)
publishedWithinDays.description: 0 = no date filter. Items without a date are kept.

includeContent.title: Include full HTML content
includeContent.description: Adds the item's full HTML content when the feed provides it (content:encoded or Atom content).

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip feeds the site asks bots not to fetch. Recommended.

item.title: Feed item
item.description: One feed item returned. Feeds that fail, are empty or are not found are free.

store.seoTitle: RSS Feed Reader API - RSS, Atom, JSON Feed to JSON
store.seoDescription: Read RSS, Atom and JSON feeds as clean JSON: titles, links, dates, authors, summaries, images, podcast audio. Auto-finds a site's feed. Date filter.
